newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Australia March house material prices rose 0.3 pct.
newsitem.headline: Australia March house material prices rose 0.3 pct.

text.p: Australian house building materials prices rose 0.3 percent in March from the previous month and were 1.1 percent higher than a year earlier, the Australian Bureau of Statistics said.
Other building materials rose 0.1 percent in the month and were 0.8 percent higher than last year, the bureau said.
The bureau said rising prices for cupboards and fittings was the main factor in the increase in the index for materials used in house building.
"This increase was partly offset by small price decreases for a range of materials," it said.
The price index for materials used in other construction rose mainly because of higher prices for bituminous plastic sheeting.
This was offset by falls in prices for elevators, escalators and travelators.
